correctStatements.text: At 11:35 Zainab reported CI failing everywhere because uploads to the artifact store returned no space left.
At 11:39 Torsten saw the volume at 100 percent with 2 terabytes used.
Torsten found the retention cleanup had not run since the scheduler move on the 3rd.
Ugo said two release trains were waiting and one had been due to go out at noon.
At 11:52 Wilhelmina decided to manually delete snapshot builds older than 14 days first.
At 12:08 Wilhelmina freed 640 GB, leaving the volume at 68 percent.
At 12:14 Zainab saw CI go green and began retriggering the failed pipelines.
At 12:40 Ugo confirmed both release trains had shipped.
At 12:45 Torsten re-enabled the retention job and ran it once successfully.
Torsten will add the retention job to the scheduler configuration in version control.
Zainab will set up an alert at 80 percent volume usage.
Wilhelmina summarised that a retention job lost in a scheduler migration filled the artifact disk and halted CI for about 40 minutes.
